The hotel itself was well-kept and clean, with exceptionally helpful and attentive staff who catered to our every need. The location was perfect, with easy access to various shops, cafes, and metro. The French-style breakfast spread at the hotel was delectable and provided a delightful start to our day.
Downside_Review: Perhaps the only minor issue was the slightly small size of the room. But considering the typical room size in central Paris, it was quite understandable and did not affect our overall stay.
